title: Cleaning crew
question: Who cleans up the debris?
intervention: Watch the Recyclers on the debris patch: the Debris overlay (Lab → Observe) shows how much debris is left in each cell. Then open the resource history to see how the Recyclers’ numbers and living biomass change.
predictedTradeoff: Recyclers turn debris into body and energy. The debris is finite, so a group that grows fast may run out.
confounds: Dead organisms add debris of their own, so the debris in the dish can grow as well as shrink. Only debris eaten counts toward the goal.

completion.journalStamp: Watched a cleaning crew eat debris
